pages.title: More Than Bread
pages.text: A varied menu has its own practical benefit.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The food-variety system determines eligible foods. Repeats do not fill different slots; this grants a small movement bonus and is not a mandatory diet.

pages.title: Five different eligible foods within the last 60 minutes of playt
pages.text: Five different eligible foods within the last 60 minutes of playtime grant 5% base movement speed. Repeats add no new slot; old entries expire from the window.
